name: ai-usage-meter
description: AI Usage Meter: your 5-hour, weekly and context figures in a band above the prompt and a /meter pane, with session-notes warnings; works with or without the AI Usage Meter strip (unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic)

useStripSettings.title: Use the strip's Settings when it is installed
useStripSettings.description: On: when the AI Usage Meter strip is installed, its Settings window decides the levels, colours and notifications, and the values below are not used. Off: the values below always apply.

warn1.title: Limits: first warning (%)
warn1.description: Session (5-hour) and Week turn orange, with a message, from this percentage.

warn2.title: Limits: second warning (%)
warn2.description: Session (5-hour) and Week turn red, with a message, from this percentage.

sessLevel1.title: Context: yellow from (% of compaction)
sessLevel1.description: Compress turns yellow and asks you to finish the task and update your session notes.

sessLevel2.title: Context: red from (% of compaction)
sessLevel2.description: Compress turns red and asks you to start a new session. Must be higher than the yellow level.

notify.title: Message at the limit warnings
notify.description: A short message inside Claude Code when Session or Week reaches a warning level.

notifyReset.title: Message when a limit resets
notifyReset.description: A short message when the 5-hour or weekly limit has reset.

notifyCompaction.title: Message when compaction has run
notifyCompaction.description: A short message reminding you to check paths, rules and decisions after compaction.

blink.title: Blink at red
blink.description: At the red context level, the Compress figure and the "start a new session" line blink until the context drops back.

robot.title: Little robot in the band
robot.description: A small pixel robot beside Details: it blinks, scans while Claude works, its antenna shows the Compress colour, and it cheers when Close session says it is safe. In the terminal it is a short text face.

staleMinutes.title: Figures are old after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: After this many minutes without new figures, the limits are dimmed and the band says how old they are (10 to 1440).
